tm.「このように おそろしい時だからこそ\n 気持ちを 落ち着けなければなりません…: "Precisely because these are such terrible times, we must calm our hearts... For now, let us only pray to the gods...
tm.「ヒノノギ火山で おこなう儀式は\n 里を守るため 絶対に欠かせぬものだ。\n: "The ritual at Mount Huji is vital to protect our village. We cannot stand idle over a mere monster.
tm.「ヒノノギ火山へ向かった神官は\n 西どなりの山道で 化け物に襲われたという。\: "The priest who headed to Mount Huji was attacked by a monster on the mountain path to the west. Be sure to slay it.
tm.「待っていたぞ ホムラの里の救世主。\n いや……世界に 光をもたらす者\n 勇: "I've been waiting, savior of Hotto. No... {var:1}, the hero who brings light to the world.
tm.「ふふ…… 私とて 巫女のはしくれ。\n ラーのしずくを持ってきたときの 目を見: "Heh... Even I am a shrine maiden. When you brought the Drop of Ra, I saw it in your eyes and was certain you were the hero.
tm.「そなたの使命は 邪悪なるものを打ち滅ぼし\n 世界中の 人々を救うこと……。: "Your mission is to destroy evil and save the people of the world...
tm.「いにしえの時代より ヒノノギ火山の火口には\n 聖なるチカラが 宿っていると言: "Since ancient times, the crater of Mount Huji is said to hold sacred power.
tm.「もしかすると その聖なるチカラが\n そなたの助けに なるかもしれん。\n さ: "That sacred power may help you. Please, take this.
tm.「……私が まだ わらべの頃に\n こういった 言い伝えを聞いたことがある。: "...When I was still a child, I heard this legend.
tm.「炎の山の頂にて 聖なる種火を投げいれし時\n はるか いにしえより伝わる\n: "When a sacred flame is cast on the mountain's peak, the great forge handed down since ancient times will revive...
tm.「……そういった伝承を守るため 火山の頂上は\n 長い間 禁足地として 封じられ: "To preserve that legend, the summit has long been sealed as forbidden ground. But for you, it's different.
tm.「{var:1}よ。勇者の使命を果たすため\n 禁足地の鍛冶場を 大いに役立てて: "{var:1}, use the forbidden forge to fulfill the hero's mission. I'll pray here for your safe journey...
tm.「私が まだ わらべの頃に\n こういった 言い伝えを聞いたことがある。: "When I was still a child, I heard this legend.
tm.「来てくれたのだね 旅の者たちよ。\n そなたたちの助けがなければ 私は あやう: "You came, travelers. Without your help, I'd have been dyed body and soul into a firedrake.
tm.「火竜は 人を食らう 邪悪な魔物……。\n もし 私が火竜になっていたらと思うと: "The firedrake is an evil man-eating monster... I shudder to think what if I'd become one.
tm.「しかし あのような希少な品を見つけてくるとは\n そなたには 感謝しても しき: "And you even found such a rare item. I can never thank you enough. Please, take this.
tm.「その品は いにしえより ホムラの里に伝わる\n 風や 雷をも裂くと言われる名刀: "That blade, handed down in Hotto since ancient times, is said to cleave wind and lightning. I'm sure you'll wield it well.
tm.「そなたもまた 浅からぬ業を背負い\n 少なからぬ縁のため 剣を振るうのだろう。: "You too bear a deep burden, and wield your sword for bonds not few. I pray Ironcleaver supports you.
tm.「そなたに渡した刀は 古くより この里に伝わる\n 風や 雷をも裂くと言われる名: "The blade I gave you, handed down here since ancient times, cleaves wind and lightning. You'll wield it well.
tm.「いいか お前たち！\n 今までより ぎょうさん 武器を作って\n 異国に売って: "Listen up, you lot! Make more weapons than ever and sell them abroad for gold!
tm.「火の神さまへの 捧げ物を用意するには\n ぎょうさん ゼニが必要じゃからの！\: "We need plenty of gold for offerings to the fire god! Don't slack off even if a firedrake shows up!
tm.「化け物が出ようが 関係ない。\n わしらは わらべの頃から ここで育った。\n: "Monster or no monster, it doesn't matter. We grew up here since we were kids. We can't live in some other village now.
tm.「わしは この里しか知らんし それで構わん。\n これから 何があろうと\n ホ: "I only know this village, and that's fine. Whatever happens, I'll bury my bones in Hotto.
tm.「おいっ お前ら！\n まだ わしが残っとるじゃろ！\n 開けろっ！ 開けんかぁ: "Hey, you lot! I'm still out here! Open up! Open the door!!
tm.「キサマら 人食い火竜が出たというのに\n わしを 閉めだしおって……！\n こ: "You shut me out when a man-eating firedrake showed up...! Whose forge do you think this is!
tm.「もし 今後も わしの身に何かあったら\n キサマらの夢枕に 毎晩 立って\n: "If anything happens to me, I'll haunt your dreams every night for generations!
tm.「なぜ ヤヤクさまが 火竜をかばって\n 死んでしまったのかは わからぬが 今ま: "I don't know why Miko died shielding the firedrake, but she protected us all this time.
tm.「今はただ ヤヤクさまと ハリマさまの\n おふたりが 安らかに眠れるように\n: "Now I can only pray like this that Miko and Ryu rest in peace...
tm.「せっかく 貢ぎ物を捧げにきたというのに\n 今日も ヤヤクさまは お留守か……: "I came to offer tribute, but Miko is out again today... What's going on?
tm.「凶暴化した魔物が 外を うろついておるのに\n こんな時に 我々を放っておくな: "Monsters run wild outside, and she leaves us alone now. Is that fitting for our village's guardian maiden...
tm.「ヤヤクさまとハリマさまが倒した 人食い火竜は\n この ホムラの里ができる ず: "The man-eating firedrake Miko and Ryu defeated had made Mount Huji its lair long before Hotto was founded.
tm.「時折 退治しようとする者も現れたそうだが\n 誰ひとり 戻ってくる者はいなかっ: "They say some tried to slay it from time to time, but none ever returned. The firedrake was a being of deep ties indeed...
tm.「ここは ヤヤクさまの自室。\n 誰も入れるなと 命じられていますゆえ\n 立ち: "This is Miko's private room. I've been ordered to let no one in, so please refrain from entering.
tm.「先ほど聞こえた 鳴き声は……。\n まさか……人を食らう火竜が\n 黄泉から: "That cry earlier... Could the man-eating firedrake have returned from the netherworld...?
tm.「あちこちから 人の悲鳴が聞こえますが\n どうか みんな 無事でいますように…: "I hear screams from all around. I pray everyone is safe...
tm.「自らの欲望を満たすため 母親を食い殺すなど\n もはや あれは ハリマさまでは: "To satisfy his own desires, he devoured his own mother. That is no longer Ryu. Please slay that firedrake...!
tm.「お渡ししたカギで 西どなりの山門を抜ければ\n 火竜のねぐらに たどり着けまし: "Take the key I gave you through the mountain gate to the west and you'll reach the firedrake's lair. I pray for your fortune...
tm.「ヤヤクさまは 志半ばで 命を落とされましたが\n ホムラの里と ハリマさまの御: "Miko lost her life with her wish unfulfilled, but through your work, Hotto and Ryu's heart were saved...
tm.「本当に 本当に ありがとうございます……。\n 何か こまったことがありました: "Thank you, truly. If you're ever in trouble, this old woman will surely help.
tm.「おや あなたさまは……。\n その節は ホムラの里と ハリマさまの御心を\n: "Oh, it's you... Thank you for saving Hotto and Ryu's heart back then.
tm.「……何やら おこまりのようですが\n 私が お役に立てることはありますか？: "...You seem troubled. Is there anything I can do for you?
tm.「……さようでございますか。\n 何か こまったことがありましたら\n この老婆: "...I see. If you're ever in trouble, this old woman will surely help.
